origin.description: Read the system clipboard into a character vector.

arguments.name: allow_non_interactive
arguments.text: A non-interactive session is refused unless this is TRUE or CLIPR_ALLOW is TRUE.

origin.details: The text is split on newlines and is not parsed as a table. Blank lines are kept. Use read_clip_tbl for tabular text.
origin.value: A character vector. NULL when the clipboard has no readable text, with a warning.

translation.description: Read the system clipboard into a list of strings.

arguments.name: allow_non_interactive
arguments.text: A non-interactive session is refused unless this is True or CLIPR_ALLOW is the string TRUE.

translation.details: The text is split on newlines the way scan splits, including a trailing empty line and blank lines. It is not parsed as a table.
translation.value: A list of strings. None when the clipboard has no readable text, with a warning.
translation.example:
from clipr import read_clip, write_clip
write_clip("Write to clipboard")
print(read_clip())
